release_notes: Cloak evidence + reconciliation release. Every cloak reason now carries the fact that triggered it — crawler_or_tool_ua:curl/ (the signature), iprange_datacenter:52.95.0.0/8 (the matched CIDR), bot_isp:hetzner (the matched entry), geo_country:US, ip2proxy_high_fraud:87 — visible in the Click Log and click details, while aggregation strips the evidence so thresholds and grouping stay by detection layer (IpRanges::match() now returns the matched line; bot_ips/bot_signatures matches name the rule). Cloak numbers finally agree across screens: the date-filtered Campaigns list used to count safe-page clicks (M+N) while Landings/Offers and the dashboard excluded them (M) — all four surfaces share one helper now, and the filter is COALESCE(is_safe_page, 0) = 0 everywhere so pre-observability NULL rows (money-side) stay visible instead of silently vanishing. The cloak panel buckets its window in the report timezone (was UTC, next to a list bucketing by the user's timezone) and returns the exact window it computed. Self-heal DDL recreates cloak_suppressed_stats on every boot for databases the earlier build of the cloak migration had already stamped (root cause of 'empty cloak diagnostics' support cases), and a degraded database no longer fatals the panel. The cloak panel links straight into the Click Log pre-filtered (route, 24h window, stream) and the log gets ALL/SAFE/MONEY tabs plus ISP/ASN/proxy-type/verdict in click details. The bot-ISP blocklist accepts the Keitaro 'Провайдеры' format: one provider per line matched as a whole phrase (commas/dots belong to the name), generic corporate suffixes (Inc/Ltd/GmbH) and sub-3-char entries are ignored by the router and warned about next to the settings textareas (PHP/JS mirror pair). Report settings get a Group By star (starred default -> last applied -> country) and the Report button in Campaigns follows a single ticked checkbox. AFTER UPDATING, HARD-RELOAD THE PANEL ONCE (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R) — index.js has a stable filename and browsers cache the old build.
